{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep only the row with highest sample_seq for each patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check the number of unique patients after deduplication
n_patients = len(df_dedup)

print(f'Number of unique patients after deduplication: {n_patients}')"}
